extracted.intended_audience: copyeditors, typesetters, authors, printers, and book publishers
extracted.subtask_description: A publishing-style manual covering punctuation, capitalization, hyphenation, tables, type usage, abbreviations, numerals, and other typographical conventions for preparing printed and literary references.

rubrics_metrics.name: Subdivisions in literary references
rubrics_metrics.description: Use lower case for subdivisions in literary references; letters used to indicate subdivisions are to be set in italics; parentheses may be used in connection with subdivisions; subdivisions of publications: capitalization of principal words in titles of subdivisions (cf. titles of) to be roman-quoted, or capitalized without quotation marks.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index citations: 54; letters indicating subdivisions set in italics, 66; parentheses in connection with subdivisions, 66; capitalization/roman-quoting guidance for subdivisions of publications referenced at 83.

rubrics_metrics.name: Indicate suffix or prefix with hyphen
rubrics_metrics.description: Suffix or prefix should be indicated by a hyphen.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reference listed at 303 (index entry 'Suffix or prefix, indicated by hyphen, 303').

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of dashes with summarizing clauses
rubrics_metrics.description: Use dashes in connection with summarizing clauses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See guidance at entry 170 for examples and context.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use superscript (superior) figures for reference indices
rubrics_metrics.description: Use superior (superscript) figures for reference indices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cited locations: 233, 334 — covers how to set and space reference indices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Omit period after superscriptions
rubrics_metrics.description: Omit a period after superscriptions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See entry at 125 for specific treatment and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalize names/pronouns for the Supreme Being
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalize names for the Supreme Being and pronouns referring to the Supreme Being.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance and examples at entry 24.

rubrics_metrics.name: Syllabi notation and indentation
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a scheme of notation and indentation for subdivisions in syllabi.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See notation/indentation rules at 176 (syllabi scheme).

rubrics_metrics.name: Hyphen to indicate syllable division
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a hyphen to indicate syllable division when breaking words across lines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Referenced at 303 (index 'Syllable, hyphen used to indicate, 303'). See dividing rules (334) for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment and spacing of symbols
rubrics_metrics.description: Specify typographical treatment and spacing for various symbols: chemical symbols; metric symbols; monetary symbols; symbols of measurement; symbols used as reference indices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Chemical: 71, 133; metric spacing: 269; monetary spacing: 270; measurement abbreviation: (index zxx); symbols as reference indices: 232.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rules for tables and tabular work
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for setting tables: how to set headlines; whether to set two-column tables as open and tables of more than two columns as ruled; columns representing totals or percentages often set off by different type; open tables: how to set; ruled tables: box-heads and how to set rules; specimen tables provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive rules and specimens at 241–250 (see specific subentries: 241, 242, 243, 248–250). Totals/percent columns styling noted at 241/242.

rubrics_metrics.name: Technical (typographical) terms and quotation marks
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain typographical technical terms; when words or phrases are used as technical terms they should be explained; use quotation marks for words or phrases used as terms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typographical terms explanation at 351–394; use of quotation marks for words/phrases as terms noted at 77.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of initial 'The' in newspaper/magazine titles
rubrics_metrics.description: 'The' is not to be treated as part of the title of newspapers or magazines.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific rule at 43 — influences alphabetizing and citation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions and use of thick and thin spaces
rubrics_metrics.description: Define thick space and thin space and prescribe where thin-spacing should be avoided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Definitions at 261; guidance on where to avoid thin-spacing at 265; see related spacing rules throughout (e.g., monetary and metric spacing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization and spelling in thoroughfares
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalize names of thoroughfares; numbers forming part of names of thoroughfares are to be spelled out.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance at 8 (capitalization) and 100 (spelling out numbers forming part of names).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of comma for thousands
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a comma after digits indicating thousands (digit grouping).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rule referenced at 159; see numerals and number groupings section for more.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions and usage of multi-em dashes/quads/spaces
rubrics_metrics.description: Define and show illustrations for three-em dash, three-em quad, three-em space (and two-em counterparts).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Three-em dash/quad/space defined and illustrated at 261; two-em dash and two-em quad defined/illustrated at 261/262.

rubrics_metrics.name: Punctuation and treatment of time indications
rubrics_metrics.description: How to punctuate time indications and how to treat expressions for time of day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Punctuation of time indications covered at 134; treatment of time of day at 98.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of personal and formal titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for titles: academic titles to be abbreviated; civil and military titles capitalization; honorary titles; titles in direct address; titles of nobility; titles not capitalized when spelled out; titles preceding names to be spelled out in certain contexts; list of exceptions and treatment of compound parts like 'ex.', 'elect', 'general', 'lieutenant'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Various specific rules at 21–22, 92, 202 (list of exceptions and special cases).

rubrics_metrics.name: Italicization of titles of legal causes and proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles of legal causes and proceedings are to be italicized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See rule at 63 for formatting courtroom/legal titles.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization and formatting of titles of publications
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalize principal words in titles of publications; use italics for many publication types; use of roman-quotation or italics varies by type and language; titles should be correctly quoted; rules differ by type of work (books, articles, chapters, newspapers, periodicals, pamphlets, plays, poems, essays, lectures, proceedings, series, tracts, transactions, treatises, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General rule at 42 (capitalization of principal words); italics guidance at 60–61; language-specific capitalization (English, Latin, French, Italian, Spanish, Scandinavian, German, Danish, Dutch) noted at 4a; other type-specific citations across 60–83 and 201–222.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting of toasts and works of art titles
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles of toasts: capitalize principal words and roman-quote; works of art: titles to be roman-quoted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Toasts: 42, 82; works of art: 84.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setting 'To be continued' at end of articles
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on how to set the phrase 'To be continued' at the end of articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See instructions at 73 and 179 for placement and formatting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Omit hyphen with 'today/tonight/tomorrow' compounds
rubrics_metrics.description: Omit the hyphen when forming compounds with 'today', 'tonight', 'tomorrow'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules noted at 229 and 204.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting totals columns in tables
rubrics_metrics.description: Columns of totals in tables may be set in a distinctive type to set them off.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See table rules at 242 for examples and recommended treatments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Town and state in datelines
rubrics_metrics.description: How to set town and state names in a dateline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance at 50 covers punctuation and order in a date line.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of dash to indicate transition
rubrics_metrics.description: Use a dash to indicate transitions in text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See entry at 266 for examples of transitional dashes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Translation of foreign names and words
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide translation of names of foreign institutions and of foreign words or phrases where appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Translation of institutions: 22, 59; translation of foreign words/phrases: 78.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization of treaties' names
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalize the names of treaties.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See rule at 28 for treaty-name capitalization conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Formatting titles of tracts, treatises, transactions, and society proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalize principal words in titles of tracts, treatises, transactions (of societies), and proceedings; these titles are to be italicized.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capitalize principal words: 42; italicize: 60; specific entries at 54 (tracts), 60 (transactions/proceedings/treatises).

rubrics_metrics.name: Compounds with common prefixes ('tri-', 'super-', 'sub-', 'ultra-', 'un-', 'under-', 'van', 'von', 'world', 'work', 'vice', 'voL etc.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for forming and treating compounds with prefixes such as 'tri-', 'super-', 'sub-', 'ultra-', 'un-', 'under-'; rules for names beginning with 'van' and 'von'; treatment of compounds with 'world', 'work', and prefixed 'vice-'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Index references: 'Tri-' compounds 297; 'Super' 308; 'Sub' 308; 'Ultra' 209; 'Un-' 205; 'Under' 307; 'Van' and 'Von' rules at 3 and 340; 'Work' compounds 186; 'World' compounds 193; 'Vice' prefix treatment at 301.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization of names/epithets of tribes, races, and peoples
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalize names and epithets of tribes, races, and peoples.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rule located at 47; examples and exceptions provided in that section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization of members of the Christian Trinity
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalize the names of the members of the Christian Trinity.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See guidance at 24 on theological-capitalization conventions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Two-column tables: set as open
rubrics_metrics.description: Two-column tables should be set as open (not ruled).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rule referenced at 248; contrast with multi-column ruled tables (248).

rubrics_metrics.name: Avoid two-letter syllables in divisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Avoid using two-letter syllables for division labels.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guideline at 226 about readability of division labels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Explanation of parts and sizes of type
rubrics_metrics.description: Explain different parts of the body of type, provide names for different sizes of type, and describe styles of type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parts of type explained at 256; sizes named at 252; styles of type discussed at 253–257.

rubrics_metrics.name: Typesetting machines and monotype specifics
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide rules and explanations related to typesetting machines and monotype units and operation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Typesetting machines at 293–294; typographical unit explained at 351 and monotype machine unit at 359; monotype specimens and guidance elsewhere.

rubrics_metrics.name: Definitions and treatment of typographical terms
rubrics_metrics.description: Define typographical terms and supply typographical vocabulary for practitioners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive typographical-terms explanation at 351–394 (glossary-like material).

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of indefinite article before 'U' (long) forms
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on using the indefinite article before words beginning with a long 'U' sound (the 'U, long' rule).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See entry (index) at 224 for the rule (e.g., 'a' vs 'an' before U-words pronounced with consonantal y- sound).

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization rules for the phrase 'United States'
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on when 'United States' should be spelled out and when it should be abbreviated.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific rules at 103 for contexts requiring spelled-out vs. abbreviated form.

rubrics_metrics.name: Institution-specific capitalization (University of Chicago example)
rubrics_metrics.description: Capitalize special terms dealing with an institution's organization, administration, curricula, and titles of divisions, departments, officers, and courses in official work pertaining to that institution.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example and rules for University of Chicago at 40 and treatment of titles/units at 49.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use quotation marks for unusual words or phrases
rubrics_metrics.description: Use quotation marks for unusual words or phrases to set them off.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See guideline at 77 for when to quote an unusual word/phrase and at 79 for directing attention to words/phrases.

rubrics_metrics.name: Capitalization of verbs in titles and verbs derived from proper names
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for capitalizing verbs in titles of publications and how to treat verbs derived from proper names.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capitalization of verbs in titles: 41; verbs derived from proper names: 53.

rubrics_metrics.name: Setting letters affixed to verse or page numbers
rubrics_metrics.description: Letters affixed to verse or page numbers to denote fractional parts should be set in italic and spacing of such affixed letters is specified.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and examples at 66 (italics and spacing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Bible versions: abbreviations and capitalization
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide standard abbreviations for versions of the Bible and capitalization rules for version names.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Abbreviations at 109; capitalization guidance at 30.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use and abbreviation of 'versus' (v., vs.)
rubrics_metrics.description: Use and abbreviation conventions for 'versus' (v., vs.) in legal and other contexts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance at 59 and 61 for legal citations and general usage.

rubrics_metrics.name: Treatment of the vocative 'O'
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on typographical treatment of the vocative 'O' (as in 'O Lord').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See entry at 117 for punctuation and capitalization examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of numerals with 'vol.', 'chap.', 'p.' in references
rubrics_metrics.description: Use numerals with abbreviations like 'vol.', 'chap.', 'p.' in literary references; indicate when these abbreviations may be omitted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules at 337: when to use numerals and when to omit abbreviations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Syllable division rules for vowels
rubrics_metrics.description: Divide on vowels whenever possible; a single vowel forming a separate syllable in the middle of a word should be put in the first line when dividing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules for hyphenation and syllable division at 334.

rubrics_metrics.name: Metric weights and measures: designation and spacing
rubrics_metrics.description: How to designate metric weights and measures and their required spacing conventions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Metric designation and spacing guidance at ix? and specifically at 369 for spacing; see units of measurement abbreviations in related entries.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use of capitalization and small caps for resolutory words (e.g., 'Whereat')
rubrics_metrics.description: In resolutions, use capitals and small caps for words such as 'Whereat'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Example and treatment given at entry 5x (index notation).

rubrics_metrics.name: Where to avoid wide spacing
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on where wide spacing should be avoided in setting text.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommendations and examples at 365.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quoting words accompanied by definitions or to draw attention
rubrics_metrics.description: Words or phrases accompanied by definitions should be quoted; use quotation marks to draw attention to a word or phrase.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: See entries at 76 (quoted when accompanied by definition) and 79 (use to direct attention).

rubrics_metrics.name: List of hyphenated words and spelling choices
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide a list of hyphenated words; where there is more than one spelling, prescribe which spelling to use.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Comprehensive hyphenated list at 304; guidance on variant spellings at 119.

rubrics_metrics.name: Zoological terms: capitalization and italics
rubrics_metrics.description: Rules for capitalization of zoological terms and the use of italics where appropriate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Capitalization at 46; italics for scientific names at 71.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specimens of types in use (type specimens and point sizes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide specimens of type in use across many point sizes and styles (Modern, Old Style, Monotype, etc.) to illustrate appearance and recommended usage.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Extensive specimen pages showing sample text at multiple point sizes (five point through 100 point), leaded vs solid examples, and listings of available faces (pages indicated in specimen index).
